visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The for Clauses Are in the Wrong Order
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Flattening [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]] should give [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], but the program crashes with a NameError.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
matrix = [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]]
flat = [x for x in row for row in matrix]
print(flat)

solution.code:
matrix = [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]]
flat = [x for row in matrix for x in row]
print(flat)
solution.explanation: The for clauses of a comprehension run in the same order as nested loops: first the outer loop (for row in matrix), then the inner loop (for x in row). If the inner clause comes first, row does not exist yet.
